cards.back:
A person who helps you get well.
Bahasa Indonesia: dokter
Example: The doctor asks me many questions.
cards.say: doctor. A person who helps you get well. The doctor asks me many questions.

cards.back:
A person who is ill and sees a doctor.
Bahasa Indonesia: pasien
Example: The patient waits in a chair.
cards.say: patient. A person who is ill and sees a doctor. The patient waits in a chair.

cards.back:
A small place where a doctor sees people.
Bahasa Indonesia: klinik
Example: We visit the clinic near our house.
cards.say: clinic. A small place where a doctor sees people. We visit the clinic near our house.

cards.back:
A person who helps the doctor and looks after patients.
Bahasa Indonesia: perawat
Example: The nurse takes my temperature.
cards.say: nurse. A person who helps the doctor and looks after patients. The nurse takes my temperature.

cards.back:
A time you agree to see someone.
Bahasa Indonesia: janji temu
Example: I have an appointment at ten.
cards.say: appointment. A time you agree to see someone. I have an appointment at ten.

cards.back:
A room where you sit before you see the doctor.
Bahasa Indonesia: ruang tunggu
Example: We sit in the waiting room.
cards.say: waiting room. A room where you sit before you see the doctor. We sit in the waiting room.

cards.back:
How hot or cold something is, for example your body.
Bahasa Indonesia: suhu
Example: The nurse checks my temperature.
cards.say: temperature. How hot or cold something is, for example your body. The nurse checks my temperature.

cards.back:
A tool that shows how hot something is.
Bahasa Indonesia: termometer
Example: The thermometer is under my arm.
cards.say: thermometer. A tool that shows how hot something is. The thermometer is under my arm.

cards.back:
A small needle that puts medicine into your body.
Bahasa Indonesia: suntikan
Example: The injection hurts for a second.
cards.say: injection. A small needle that puts medicine into your body. The injection hurts for a second.

cards.back:
A small hard piece of medicine that you swallow.
Bahasa Indonesia: tablet
Example: Take one tablet after lunch.
cards.say: tablet. A small hard piece of medicine that you swallow. Take one tablet after lunch.

cards.back:
A thick, sweet liquid medicine.
Bahasa Indonesia: obat sirup
Example: The cough syrup tastes sweet.
cards.say: syrup. A thick, sweet liquid medicine. The cough syrup tastes sweet.

cards.back:
A soft thick medicine that you put on your skin.
Bahasa Indonesia: krim atau salep
Example: The nurse puts cream on my arm.
cards.say: cream. A soft thick medicine that you put on your skin. The nurse puts cream on my arm.

cards.back:
A small sticky cover for a cut.
Bahasa Indonesia: plester
Example: I have a plaster on my finger.
cards.say: plaster. A small sticky cover for a cut. I have a plaster on my finger.

cards.back:
A feeling that something hurts.
Bahasa Indonesia: rasa sakit
Example: I feel a pain in my leg.
cards.say: pain. A feeling that something hurts. I feel a pain in my leg.

cards.back:
To feel pain.
Bahasa Indonesia: terasa sakit
Example: My knee hurts a lot.
cards.say: hurt. To feel pain. My knee hurts a lot.

cards.back:
A dull pain that lasts for some time.
Bahasa Indonesia: nyeri
Example: I have an ache in my back.
cards.say: ache. A dull pain that lasts for some time. I have an ache in my back.

cards.back:
Red marks on the skin.
Bahasa Indonesia: ruam
Example: I have a red rash on my arm.
cards.say: rash. Red marks on the skin. I have a red rash on my arm.

cards.back:
To look at something carefully.
Bahasa Indonesia: memeriksa
Example: The doctor will check my ears.
cards.say: check. To look at something carefully. The doctor will check my ears.

cards.back:
Less ill than before.
Bahasa Indonesia: lebih baik
Example: I feel better now.
cards.say: better. Less ill than before. I feel better now.
